comparison_caveats: Historical: each client process and corresponding server backend flows on one worker. Current: each client process has one flow on each of four workers; same-worker backend per client flow; all workers each have 4 ingress and 4 backend flows.

Sequential preflight ensures deterministic placement; common start barrier matches historical load interval. Overall client watchdog increased 90s to 300s for preparation; per-RPC deadline remains 5s.
Current code/build compared with historical binary: does not isolate an individual implementation change.
